name: us-market-investment-copilot
description: Personal market and investment copilot for U.S. and Saudi equities with evidence-backed research, valuation, catalysts, technical context, risk management, and opportunity ranking.

interface.shortDescription: US & Saudi equity research and opportunity ranking.
interface.longDescription: Researches U.S. and Saudi equities, analyzes earnings and catalysts, evaluates valuation and technical context, ranks risk-adjusted opportunities, monitors thesis invalidation, and explains market drivers with source-backed evidence.
interface.defaultPrompt: Analyze the market and surface the strongest risk-adjusted stock opportunities for my configured horizon, clearly separating evidence, assumptions, catalysts, risks, entry logic, and invalidation conditions.
